name: sigma_expansion
summary: Closed-form Taylor expansion of P_red(sigma)=|J_red|^2/(|J_red|^2+|J_blue|^2) around sigma=1/2.

provenance.origin: First committed to this repository on 2026-07-31. Claim as recorded in the wiki: P_red(sigma) - 1/2 ≈ c1·d + c3·d³ (d=sigma-1/2) is derivable in closed form — not fitted — from moments of the underlying Dirichlet-style projection. The raw |J_red(sigma)|² + |J_blue(sigma)|² is NOT constant across sigma; it has a genuine minimum at sigma=1/2, not a flat quantum-probability-style conservation.
provenance._draft: origin and created are machine-drafted from git history and the wiki claim; the author has not yet reviewed them
